note: Hand-written: what each lineage step did, read from its hunks (node dev/tools/lineage/lineage.js show <id>), the package READMEs and the commit messages, and the framework that owns that concern today. Used by dev/stage-3h-modernization/tools/lineage_doc.js for STEPS.md.

B03: The multiplayer seam: the frame loop calls window.__mp(...) every frame (mp.js); the carpet texture path becomes relative (./assets/carpet.png)

B05: Network hooks window.__net (respawn, join, tick, collected); window.__api is published for the first time (G, q, V, el, H, yu, started, paused, win)
B06: The bundle draws the other players (drawPeers from window.__peerLights); __api gains look, lamps, audio, revive, tp, mkAvatar, layer, unwin

B08: Hooks to gore.js (__gore.wounds, fx, corpse) and sfx.js (__sfx.play for footsteps)
